_meta.description: Deterministic CloudFormation fix catalog (WS-13). The CFN analogue of fix-rules.json. Static, checked-in data: the model does not write to it at runtime. Each rule is an ADDITIVE, single-property fix that adds (or, for a wrong literal, rewrites) one property under a resource's Properties map. Every rule here was verified against the 5 CFN fixtures: it produces a valid unified diff, survives cfn-lint with no new errors, and makes the Checkov finding disappear on re-run.
_meta.corpus: tests/fixtures/cfn-0*/ (5 fixtures, 66 total Checkov findings, 34 distinct rules)

excluded.CKV_AWS_119: DynamoDB CMK encryption. The fixtures ALREADY carry SSESpecification:{SSEEnabled:true} and Checkov still fires: it demands a customer-managed CMK (KMSMasterKeyId + a KMS key + its policy). That is a companion + a key-policy decision, not a single additive property. Exactly the plausible-looking WRONG fix WS-5 warns about (SSEEnabled:true looks like it should satisfy it; it does not).
excluded.CKV_AWS_18: S3 access logging. Needs a destination bucket (a companion) and which bucket receives logs is an operational choice. Diff-only territory, deferred to the LLM path.
excluded.CKV_AWS_158: CloudWatch log-group KMS. Needs a KMS key AND its key policy (never-auto-apply category 4).
excluded.CKV_AWS_173: Lambda env-var KMS. Needs a customer CMK, and per run_checkov.py's note this rule is the wrong fix for the real problem (plaintext secrets): turning it green leaves the credentials in git.
excluded.CKV_AWS_117: Lambda in VPC. Needs real subnet + security-group IDs; not synthesizable.
excluded.CKV_AWS_116: Lambda DLQ. Needs a target queue/topic AND an execution-role grant the patch cannot add.
excluded.CKV_AWS_23: SecurityGroup rule descriptions. Multi-attribute rewrite of the ingress/egress list, and the resource type is never-auto-apply anyway.
excluded.CKV_AWS_157: RDS MultiAZ. The fixtures parameterize it with !If [IsProduction, true, false]; forcing true throws away a deliberate choice and is availability, not security.
excluded.CKV_AWS_111/108/109: IAM policy scope. Never-auto-apply category 2 and never a single additive property.

CKV_AWS_16.title: RDS instance storage is encrypted
CKV_AWS_16.rationale: Single property. The fixtures set StorageEncrypted:false (a literal), so this degrades to a literal->literal modify, which the safety line still allows (SPEC lists storage_encrypted=true as auto-applicable).

CKV_AWS_161.title: RDS instance has IAM database authentication enabled
CKV_AWS_161.rationale: Additive single property. Enables an additional auth path; grants nothing away and does not disable password auth.

CKV_AWS_26.title: SNS topic is encrypted at rest
CKV_AWS_26.rationale: Additive single property. Uses the AWS-managed alias alias/aws/sns, so no KMS key or key policy is created and there is nothing to lock anyone out of.

CKV_AWS_27.title: SQS queue is encrypted at rest
CKV_AWS_27.rationale: Additive single property. Checkov CKV_AWS_27 checks only that Properties/KmsMasterKeyId is present (ANY_VALUE); the AWS-managed alias alias/aws/sqs satisfies it with no key or policy to manage.

CKV_AWS_28.title: DynamoDB table has point-in-time recovery enabled
CKV_AWS_28.rationale: Additive single block. Enables continuous backups; access-neutral.

CKV_AWS_21.title: S3 bucket has versioning enabled
CKV_AWS_21.rationale: Additive single block. Versioning is the canonical additive, no-access-impact S3 fix.

CKV_AWS_115.title: Lambda function has a reserved-concurrency limit
CKV_AWS_115.rationale: Additive single property. Caps concurrent executions (a blast-radius / cost control). Verified to close on both AWS::Lambda::Function and AWS::Serverless::Function.

CKV_AWS_51.title: ECR repository has immutable image tags
CKV_AWS_51.rationale: Additive single property. Immutable tags prevent tag-overwrite supply-chain attacks; access-neutral.

CKV_AWS_43.title: Kinesis stream is encrypted with KMS
CKV_AWS_43.rationale: Additive single block. Uses the AWS-managed alias alias/aws/kinesis, so no CMK or key policy is created.

CKV_AWS_7.title: KMS key has rotation enabled
CKV_AWS_7.rationale: The fix (EnableKeyRotation: true) is genuinely additive and safe, but the resource is an AWS::KMS::Key -- a never-auto-apply resource type (SPEC 6.3 category 4). We emit the diff so the finding closes on review, but never auto-apply anything on a KMS key, because the blast radius of a key mistake is bricked decryption. Diff-only, structurally enforced by the never-list.

CKV_AWS_17.title: RDS instance is not publicly accessible
CKV_AWS_17.rationale: PubliclyAccessible: false is the correct secure value, but flipping it REMOVES a network path. Anything reaching the database over its public endpoint goes dark. That is access-affecting, so it is diff-only regardless of confidence -- PubliclyAccessible is on the CFN never-auto-apply attribute list.
